settings.resources.title: Search resource budget
settings.resources.help: The CPU budget limits search threads as a share of logical processors. The GPU budget controls the compute duty cycle; 0% disables GPU search. Actual utilization depends on the query and may vary in Task Manager.
settings.resources.maximum_help: At 100%, no deliberate throttling is applied and search can use available compute resources. Auto / CPU Only mode still applies. High load may affect game responsiveness. Changes apply to the next search and are locked while searching.
settings.resources.status: Saved: the next search can use up to {0} CPU threads. GPU use depends on the compute mode and query.
settings.resources.cpu_only_status: Saved: the next search can use up to {0} CPU threads. GPU search is disabled.
settings.resources.busy: A search is running, so resource budgets are locked. Adjust them after it finishes; changes apply to the next search.
settings.optimizations.title: Search optimizations
settings.optimizations.help: Enabled options may be used automatically on supported search paths. Other paths keep their correct original behavior. Gains vary with the query. Changes apply to the next search.
settings.optimizations.prefix_cache.help: Main benefit: large searches. Reuses shared seed calculations during continuous enumeration and supported candidate filtering.
settings.optimizations.exact_draw.help: Applies to opening curses and supported Leafy conditions. Uses equivalent, simpler draw checks while preserving the same matches.
settings.optimizations.leafy.help: Applies to Leafy conditions with two targets where the shortcut is safe. Skips preparation for the second draw when the first already fails.
settings.optimizations.cost_order.help: Applies to opening checks, ordered merchant sequences and supported multi-stage routes. Considers cost, rejection rate and candidate population. Also controls the supported four-lane CPU prefilter (requires the seed prefix cache); enabled only when the same matches are guaranteed.
settings.optimizations.grouped_output.he: Main benefit: large single-player opening searches. Writes passing candidates in groups to reduce repeated waiting.
settings.optimizations.double_window.hel: Main benefit: supported large single-player Leafy searches at a 100% GPU budget. Combines adjacent batches and uses about 180 MiB extra GPU memory; falls back to one window when unavailable.
settings.optimizations.early_readback.he: Main benefit: frequent GPU batches and opening filters with sparse survivors. Schedules status and small candidate transfers earlier to reduce repeated waits; larger outputs are still read in full.
settings.optimizations.status: Saved: {0}/{1} enabled. Checkpoints, presets and existing results are preserved.
settings.optimizations.busy: A search is running, so optimization settings are locked. Adjust them after it finishes; changes apply to the next search.
settings.language.help: Choose the interface language. Changes apply immediately.
settings.run_prediction.title: In-run prediction shortcut
settings.run_prediction.help: Show a Bones icon below the run information at the top right for supported live events such as Crystal Sphere. You can also switch to this seed’s opening information. Off by default.
settings.origin.title: Search starting seed
settings.origin.help: The first search and Randomize choose eight random leading characters followed by 0000. Search then scans consecutive seeds and saves progress, without randomizing each block. Saved progress and manually entered 12-character seeds are preserved. Applying a seed resets the next search position.
settings.origin.unset: No starting seed yet. The first search will choose eight random leading characters followed by 0000.

query.neow.guide.title: Neow · Guide
query.neow.guide.usage: Select the relic you want Neow to offer on the left, then filter its random results on the right. After selecting Bones, specify its two internal relics below on the left.
query.neow.guide.pickup_order: Bones pickup order determines which relic consumes RNG first. When the two relics affect each other's RNG, obtaining the specified results may require a fixed pickup order. During your run, pick them up in the specified order to ensure matching results.

query.combat.guide.title: Combat rewards · Guide
query.combat.guide.usage: Filter card and potion rewards from the first 1–6 normal combats. Cards and potions can independently target specific battles or any battles within their range.
query.combat.guide.legality: Candidates follow the current character and unlocks; selected conditions are preserved. This predicts rewards, not whether a map contains these consecutive combats.
query.combat.notice.removed_invalid: Shorter battle range removed {0} conditions outside the range
query.shop.guide.title: Shop · Guide
query.shop.guide.usage:
Choose how many upcoming shops to search. Enable Specific shops to pin relic or colorless-card targets to individual shop ordinals.
The third relic slot—the shop relic—is usually comparatively stable, while colorless cards are more sensitive to extra RNG consumption. Courier restocks and the fake merchant can change the continuation and later shop results. The current filter does not model those extra consumptions.
query.relic.guide.title: Relic sequences · Guide
query.relic.guide.usage:
Choose a range, then choose the target relic. By default, it must appear within the first N positions of its corresponding sequence; Advanced adds exact-position and exclusion conditions.
Relic rarity is chosen before the game consumes the matching relic sequence. A sequence match therefore does not guarantee this will be the first relic you obtain. Chest rooms use an additional relic sequence and must be considered separately.
query.ancient.guide.title: Ancients · Guide
query.ancient.guide.usage: Default lets you choose one Ancient and one optional offer for each of Acts 2 and 3. Open Advanced to switch between any offered option and an offered option group, including Neow offers, multiple Ancients, or a group of options. Each mode keeps its own conditions; only the current mode is used in a search.
query.ancient.guide.multiplayer: In multiplayer, each Act's Ancient identity is shared: changing it on any player page updates everyone. Advanced is also a party-wide toggle; each player keeps their own option requirement type and targets.
query.ancient.guide.premise: Some Ancient options require a qualifying deck or state. Selecting one commits that its eligibility is met when you encounter that Ancient. RT2 predicts the offer under that premise; it does not prove the premise can be reached.
query.ancient.party.title: Shared Acts 2–3 identities · P{0} options
query.ancient.party.group_requires_one: Narrow the shared Ancient identity to one before requiring an offered option group.
query.event.guide.title: Events · Guide
query.event.guide.usage: Choose an Act, queue range and inclusion or exclusion, then add an event. Included events expose their result editor inline. Multiple conditions for the same event share its result requirements. Single-player transformation sources can be combined.
query.event.guide.boundary: Event availability has many prerequisites, and some internal outcomes cannot be predicted reliably. This page exposes only conditions RT2 can currently express and predict; use ? for detailed mechanics, requirements, and prediction limits.
query.event.picker.title: Choose an Act {0} event

query.act_info.guide.title: Act information · Guide
query.act_info.guide.usage: Choose a map scope and the route objective you want to find. For a single Act, Advanced map feature filters can further describe the map.
query.act_info.guide.boundary: Whole run filters an overall route objective; map features describe one Act. Multiple route objectives cannot be combined into a same-path search.
query.act_info.identity.guide.title: Boss / Variant · Guide
query.act_info.identity.guide.usage: Choose the Bosses and map variants you want. Nothing is restricted by default; after selecting one or more options, only those results pass.
query.act_info.identity.guide.boundary: Multiple selections use OR semantics. With no selection, no corresponding condition is added.
query.map.guide.title: Map nodes · Guide
query.map.guide.usage: The four scopes show their condition counts. Route objectives require a route with the selected number of nodes. Add per-Act map properties, edit their values directly, or remove them.
query.map.guide.boundary: Whole-run and per-Act route objectives are exclusive. Additional properties are independent checks, not a promise that one route satisfies all of them. Map filters do not simulate actions or combat outcomes.
